anomaly_label: Data acquisition interruption and increase in pressure

evidence.observation: H701 reads 376.069 °C, markedly above H702 at 57.791 °C and the reboiler vessel at 55.223 °C.

The extreme heater-temperature discrepancy persists: H701 is 381.585 °C, H702 is 69.960 °C, and the vessel is 60.934 °C. These readings flag a thermal or measurement anomaly but do not distinguish its cause.

Distillate and reflux flows remain present at 0.326 and 1.210; cooling-water flow is 5.854 and both level switches remain at 1. These channels do not independently corroborate the extreme H701 temperature.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint and permitted temperature range, heater-power/control history, and an independent H701 temperature measurement are needed to distinguish actual overheating from sensor error. Pressure instruments are not installed. No composition measurement or separation target has been supplied.
